description: Export a model from the local WoW install's game files into a folder, headless. M2 models become glTF with animations (or GLB/OBJ); WMO models become OBJ+MTL (or glTF). Textures are decoded to PNG beside the model in the game's folder layout, so relative texture paths resolve in Blender. The first call opens the game storage and takes about 30 seconds. Needs the game-data and model-data syncs.

animations.description: Include animations for M2 glTF. Default true.

flavor.description: Which installed client to read: mainline (retail), forever, classic or vanilla. Defaults to the first install found.

format.description: Default: gltf for M2, obj for WMO.

outputDir.description: Folder to write into (created if missing).

splitGroups.description: WMO OBJ: one object per group.

name: wow_model_export
title: Export a game model
